title: Spicy Korean Chicken Stew
description: A flavor-packed stew made with spicy Korean chili flakes, velvety chicken, and a hint of sweetness. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Add chicken and cook until browned, 5-6 minutes.
Add soy sauce, gochujang, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, 15-20 minutes.
Stir in green onions and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
